items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: His wife Marge is a musician and a great lady I would say and they knew everybody, all of the movie stars.

ctx.x: I loved to hear him talk. He knew some history.

I always wanted to be like him. His wife Marge is a musician and a great lady I would say and they knew everybody, all of the movie stars. I said gee I would like to see my wife and I someday know people like Zooty. I think we were trying to get to that sort of point.
